URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/30/russia-warns-nato-of-possible-nuclear-response-if-kaliningrad-is-cut-off
Al Jazeera (credited to Reuters) — published 30 September 2026

Russia has warned NATO it is prepared to use its entire arsenal, including nuclear weapons, if the Western alliance attempts to cut off the Baltic exclave of Kaliningrad, according to a diplomatic document sent to member states.
The diplomatic memo sent on Wednesday claimed Moscow has "information that NATO is preparing an air and naval blockade of Kaliningrad".
NATO's response came through its Secretary-General Mark Rutte, who said that NATO is a defensive alliance and that Russia should "stop the nuclear threats", calling the document unhelpful. Rutte also downplayed the seriousness of the threat, saying that "Putin knows that he can never win" in a direct escalation with NATO.
Bordered by Poland and Lithuania, both NATO members, Kaliningrad sits on the Baltic Sea. The region houses Russia's Baltic fleet and nuclear-ready Iskander missile systems.
